chunking: odd-number export-traces --out <dir> (max 200,000 chars per chunk; one results file and one treatment per chunk)
readers: one agent per chunk, open-ended prompt (no codebook), verbatim quotes required; 42 chunks read by claude-opus-5 before the run was moved to claude-sonnet-5 for cost, 66 by claude-sonnet-5
syntheses: one claude-opus-5 agent per model over all of its chunk readings, in notes/trace-syntheses/
